help.faq.title: Frequently asked
help.faq.modify.question: How do I change a reservation?
help.faq.modify.answer: Open Reservations, choose an upcoming reservation and tap Modify. You can change the date, time, party size and preferences.
help.faq.cancel.question: Is there a cancellation fee?
help.faq.cancel.answer: No. You can cancel an upcoming reservation free of charge at any time before it begins.
help.faq.demo.question: Is the availability real?
help.faq.demo.answer: Not yet. Restaurants, reviews and availability in this version are demonstration data, and reservations are stored only on this device.
